claims.text: CA pain: opioids have proven efficacy for CA pain and as part of palliative care.
claims.quote: Opioid analgesics have proven efficacy in the treatment of acute pain, cancer pain, and pain at the end of life and as part of palliative care.

claims.text: Generally they should ⍉be withheld for CA pain; SE can be prevented or managed, and addiction = less of a concern.
claims.quote: Generally, opioids should not be withheld when treating cancer pain; in such cases, adverse effects can be prevented or managed, and addiction is less of a concern.
